description: Boss registry — all 8 factions, tiered mini/champion/major. F001 bosses derived from realm template pending approval; F004 major boss passes the originality filter (renamed, approved).

bosses.name: The Stair-Phantoms
bosses.summary: the ascent that lies with mirage-light

bosses.name: The Shattered Engine
bosses.summary: fused light-fragments; eats rejoining radiance

bosses.name: The Lightless One of Broken Praise
bosses.summary: attacks with anti-light; win by embracing your shadow

bosses.name: The False Pact Wardens
bosses.summary: every ability costs extra while they live

bosses.name: The Ash Court Usurper
bosses.summary: wields Dominion law as a weapon

bosses.name: The Volcanic Glass Magistrate
bosses.summary: beat it by beating the law: the founding contract was eaten

bosses.name: The Grayfell Colossus
bosses.summary: a hollowed old-growth that walks

bosses.name: The Spore-Mother
bosses.summary: kill the color out of her before she grays the realm

bosses.name: The First Stump
bosses.summary: cannot be killed, only outlasted — endurance exam; absorbed the witness of the beginning

bosses.name: The Unweighed
bosses.summary: a Hollow that avoided its verdict; fights from shadow patches the noonlight cannot reach

bosses.name: The Glare-Sworn Archon
bosses.summary: leader of the light-swimmers; wears a stolen sun

bosses.name: The Unshamed
bosses.summary: a god-shaped Hollow that refuses to be weighed — verdict-light slides off it; win by forcing it under the scale

bosses.name: The Forgotten Standard Bearer
bosses.summary: the pre-Collapse king who swore to hold the bridge and failed

bosses.name: Oathmaw
bosses.summary: a Hollow that learned to speak promises — it sounds exactly like someone you trust

bosses.name: The First Perjurer
bosses.summary: a god-shaped Hollow, the first ever to break a divine vow. [SECRET-tier: WHAT was the vow — mid-campaign reveal anchor]

bosses.name: The Vapored Oracle
bosses.summary: mightiest of the oracle-maddened shades; fights you with your own future

bosses.name: The Victory Parasite
bosses.summary: imitates BOTH legal systems (Laurel Agon + Stormmoot) to exploit jurisdictional chaos

bosses.name: The Thunder Tribunal Usurper
bosses.summary: Hollow wearing the shape of a forgotten pre-Collapse judge; every judgment has physical weight. [SECRET-tier: whose shape is it REALLY wearing?]

bosses.name: The False Reflection
bosses.summary: your own copy, fighting without conviction

bosses.name: The Boundary-Thief Matron
bosses.summary: a Hollow that steals spirits and wears the shells

bosses.name: The False Reflection Sovereign
bosses.summary: the Gate's most perfect imitation; victory requires proving the threshold still has authority. [SECRET-tier: reflections need an original — no such original exists. What is it reflecting?]. RENAME APPLIED (BudE404 approved)

bosses.name: The Rootbound Changeling
bosses.summary: rearranges the labyrinth mid-fight

bosses.name: The Beast-Realm Predator
bosses.summary: constraint-combat: you cannot win by destroying the terrain it nests in
